summary: Bundle bndl-09d0d60e11897238 (Northside Clinic, 2026-11-10 06:13-15:13 UTC). The evidence does not support an incident. No local log removal, data staging, or policy-violating transfer was established. Findings: (1) workstation /var/log/auth.log has 16 collector-retained lines absent locally, all before the 09:03 rotation; explained by keep=1 rotation policy (F-1d953e, verified). (2) records /var/log/records-app/access.log has 199 collector-retained lines absent locally, before the 09:03 rotation whose segment was archived off-host (F-0624a5, verified; archive not inspected). (3) records transferred 17.5 MB to 10.20.0.45:873 (stor-nas-01, approved backup) at 11:47 (F-a14946, verified). (4) workstation uploaded lab PDFs via curl to 10.20.8.20 (lab-gw-01, approved) between 07:50 and 11:59 under accounts kcole and sdubois (F-0d734f, verified as structurally valid; benign reading plausible, history is host-writable). The patients.db collection-gap note was downgraded: the cited snapshot predates capture start and shows no gap. Attribution: accounts kcole, sdubois, and adm-tkim show activity; no human operator is established. Account names identify credentials, not people, and no person is accused or cleared.
